request.style: English, solo female voice, warm and intimate, acoustic guitar, piano, soft strings, cello, ambient pad, gentle and hopeful, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The well is deep and the sun is high
You have nothing to draw with, I ask you why
Who gave this water that you hold so tight
Are you greater than the father of the light

[Pre-Chorus]
Jacob gave us the well and drank from it himself
With his sons and his livestock in the field

[Chorus]
Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again
But whoever drinks the water I give will never thirst again
The water I give will become in them a spring
Welling up to eternal life

[Verse]
Sir give me this water so I will not get thirsty
And have to keep coming here to draw water from the earth
You see the need in my hands and in my soul
A deep desire that the world cannot hold

[Pre-Chorus]
Jacob gave us the well and drank from it himself
With his sons and his livestock in the field

[Chorus]
Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again
But whoever drinks the water I give will never thirst again
The water I give will become in them a spring
Welling up to eternal life

[Bridge]
Go call your husband and come back here
But I have no husband I tell you dear
You are right in saying you have no husband

[Chorus]
Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again
But whoever drinks the water I give will never thirst again
The water I give will become in them a spring
Welling up to eternal life

[Outro]
A spring of water welling up
To eternal life
